decisions.reason: Exact-order N points of E_t are finite etale on the stated open because N and its discriminant are units. H acts freely on primitive points. Orbit descent is finite etale; no invertibility of |H| is needed for finite locally constant sets. Away from j=0,1728, automorphisms are +/-1; since -1 belongs to H, twist choices disappear in H-orbits. Thus this is the intended coarse X1(N)/H generic cover, not an additional twist cover. Primitive vector count divided by |H| gives exactly Nt_H product(1+1/p). Positive genus excludes the degenerate small-level cases irrelevant to the consumer.

The retained lci/trace-dual source applies to the finite flat kernel of [n]. The invariant differential derivative is n, hence the Fitting different after zero-section base change is nA. Its inverse in the generic etale algebra is precisely n^-1 A under trace, not merely an abstract isomorphic module. Finite normalization reverses trace dual inclusion. In each normal DVR component, n times its trace dual contained in the ring means the different contains n. The nonnegative relative different exponent in a tower gives the same bound in the orbit intermediate field. No perfect residue field or tame assumption is inserted.

decisions.reason: At generic vertical points over p>3, t and t-1 are units, including when p divides N; E_t is an elliptic scheme there. Each H-orbit field embeds in a point field, so the preceding bound applies without using full splitting-field degree. Sum f_j r_j <= sum f_j e_j v_p(N)=d_H v_p(N), then normalize over K. At 2 and 3 use the separately reviewed general different bound; horizontal t=2 contributes d_H log2. Total is d_H(log12+logN+2logd_H), and the already reviewed integral evaluation theorem supplies the half factor and g_H log(2/sqrt(pi)).
